title: Invisible AI: customers don't want your platform, they want your output
description: Pricing debates focus on how to charge for AI. The SVP was asking a different question: why should he own the AI at all? The argument: For engineering services, AI should be built into how the work gets delivered, not handed over as a platform. The customer buys faster, better engineering, and the provider carries the deployment, tokens, AMC and cyber risk inside its own delivery model.
